title: Expert-Guided Class-Conditional Goodness-of-Fit Scores for Interpretable Classification with Informative Missingness
abstract: arXiv:2604.14809v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study a classification problem with three key challenges: pervasive informative missingness, the integration of partial prior expert knowledge into the learning process, and the need for interpretable decision rules. We propose a framework that encodes prior knowledge through an expert-guided class-conditional model for one or more classes, and use this model to construct a small set of interpretable goodness-of-fit features. The features quantify how well the observed data agree with the expert model, isolating the contributions of different aspects of the data, including both observed and missing components. These features are combined with a few transparent auxiliary summaries in a simple discriminative classifier, resulting in a decision rule that is easy to inspect and justify. translated_title: 面向信息性缺失下可解释分类的专家引导类条件拟合优度分数
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个具有三个关键挑战的分类问题：普遍存在的信息性缺失、将部分先验专家知识融入学习过程，以及对可解释决策规则的需求。我们提出了一个框架，通过针对一个或多个类别的专家引导类条件模型来编码先验知识，并利用该模型构建一小组可解释的拟合优度特征。这些特征量化了观测数据与专家模型的符合程度，分离出数据不同方面的贡献，包括观测部分和缺失部分。这些特征与少量透明的辅助摘要一起被输入一个简单的判别分类器，从而得到一个易于检查和论证的决策规则。我们在用于评估《全面禁止核试验条约》遵守情况的地震监测背景下开发并应用了该框架。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个专家引导的类条件拟合优度分数框架，将专家先验知识编码为可解释的拟合优度特征，以解决信息性缺失下的可解释分类问题，并成功应用于《全面禁止核试验条约》的地震监测合规评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an expert-guided class-conditional goodness-of-fit scoring framework that encodes prior expert knowledge into interpretable features for classification under informative missingness, demonstrated on seismic monitoring for Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty compliance.
